_meta: G7.1 FIRES71 (docs/G71_SCOPE.md B4 fire support, D5 kill zones, B1 thermobaric + incendiary, G1 forward observers, G2 MLRS). Last Protocol only (roster 5A Q1). Every number PROVISIONAL (untuned). Tile scale: 4 m per tile (Blast8 tile_m), so the B4 FPF strip '30-60 m out' = 7.5-15 tiles.

g71_fires._note_ledger: PROVISIONAL. Fire missions and FPF spend the side's ammo ledger (kinds.*.ammo per round, fpf.ammo_cost per face).
g71_fires._note_danger_close: PROVISIONAL. Every mission round also hits our own ground units in its splash at this fraction (the player ordered it); FireDangerClose warns when own units are inside the area at the order.

scatter._note: PROVISIONAL. tier 0 unobserved (wider), 1 seen by fog sight / drones / radar, 2 spotted by a forward observer team, a Callins designation or a counter-battery track (precise).

creeping._note: PROVISIONAL. The barrage line walks from a toward b at rate_tps tiles per second, width tiles across.

illumination._note: Empty radial slot (roster 5A Q6): I5 (wave 5) adds the rounds, the lit area and the darkness penalty.

thermobaric._note: PROVISIONAL. Fuel-air rockets (rocket guns only): damage x (1 + per_extra per extra enemy in the blast, capped at +cap): best on packed lanes.

precision._note: PROVISIONAL. Tight only when observed (tier >= 1); unobserved it scatters like any round.

gunship._note: Radial entry = the CONDUCTOR orbit (roster 5A Q19, conductor71.gd).

fpf._note: PROVISIONAL. Strip 10 tiles (40 m) out, 3 deep, along each LP outer ring face; one press = every free gun that reaches it fires its max rate for 45 s; wall weapons within wall_band of that face read Fires71.fpf_aim.

g71_killzone._note: PROVISIONAL. Painted sectors are hard (self-defence inside self_defence_r); auto zones are advisory (shown, never restrict) while auto.restrict is false.

g71_conductor._note: PROVISIONAL (B6). conductor71.gd. Orbit = Air air_patrol polygon; pulse = ticks between combat passes.
